note: Surfaces probed for a published per-city or per-zone offset register and found to carry none. Each entry states the language searched, the surface closed and the evidence.

entries.result: NO place parameter. The API answers /api/prayer-times with one national table (Baghdad) and silently ignores city, city_id, governorate and governorate_id. It DOES accept ?date=YYYY-MM-DD, so the surface is date-addressable and forward/backward harvestable, but not place-addressable.
entries.evidence: captures/iq-dws-home.html (SPA shell), captures/iq-dws-app.js (the only call is Ce.get('/prayer-times') with no params), and five probed query strings all returning 05:05/06:29/11:51/14:45/17:06/18:23
entries.record: The record's IQ-DIWAN object already says 'the app serves per-city feeds, which the record does not enumerate'. That remains true; the public web API does not expose them.

entries.result: DNS does not resolve for awqaf.gov.sy and www.awqaf.gov.sy (curl: could not resolve host). No ministry prayer-times surface reachable.
entries.note: The record's p2-mk-sy archive may hold an older ministry artifact; nothing live was reachable this session.

entries.result: ONE national table, no place selector and no place delta. The page carries a month table for Lefkoşa only.
entries.evidence: captures/cy-kktc-namaz.html: zero <option> elements, one month table, one 'Bugün' block
entries.record: Confirms the record's CY-KKTC note ('the site publishes one national table and no city table'). The mission's 'Cyprus-north 7 place offsets' is not on the publisher's public site.

entries.publisher: وزارة العدل والشؤون الإسلامية (Ministry of Justice, Islamic Affairs and Waqf)
entries.result: No prayer-times service on the ministry portal. The homepage service list is legal and endowment services only; the official times live in the iGA Bahrain app, which is not a public page.
entries.evidence: captures/bh-moj-home.txt (service list transcribed from the fetch)
entries.note: No BH object exists in the policy layer at all.

entries.result: marw.dz timed out and then answered HTTP 504 across four attempts. No live fetch this session.
entries.evidence: curl exit 28 then 504, recorded in the run log
entries.record: Algeria's layer is per-wilaya BOOKS (three 1447 books already banked at o1l-city/algeria-1447/), not an offset register, so the class does not apply even when the site answers.

entries.result: MEASURED, NOT PUBLISHED. The ilçe layer is a selector of 307 options keyed by ilceId; each ilçe gets its own computed table and the publisher states no delta between them.
entries.evidence: captures/tr-diyanet-home.html: 307 <option> elements, ilceId present in the inline script
entries.consequence: Any Turkish place register must be measured from the tables, never read as a stated ladder.

entries.publisher: Chinese Muslim Association / Taipei Grand Mosque
entries.result: No stated per-city register. The Grand Mosque embeds a third-party widget (prayer-times.mosqueprayers.workers.dev). The community platform islamtaiwan.com serves 20 county/city pages, each its own table, with no stated delta.
entries.record: The record grades Taiwan FALLBACK for exactly this reason. The '8-city table' in the mission list is not on either public surface.

entries.result: The llms.txt that carried the tier statement is gone (404) and the site now serves mosque pages only (/prayer-times, /namaz, /prayer, /times, /namaaz all 404). The record's three symmetric tiers (+2/-2, +3/-3, +4/-4) cannot be resolved to town names from the publisher.
entries.record: The record holds the tier VALUES and town COUNTS (7, 8, 8) but not the names.
